description: This Swift source file defines classes and functions related to scheduling background synchronization tasks on iOS using BGTaskScheduler (iOS 13+). It includes a final class BGTaskBackgroundSyncScheduler that manages registering, scheduling, and handling background refresh tasks, as well as a factory enum for creating appropriate scheduler instances based on system capabilities.

classes.name: BGTaskBackgroundSyncScheduler
classes.description: A class that manages background sync tasks using BGTaskScheduler, handling registration, scheduling, cancelation, and execution of background refresh tasks.

classes.name: BackgroundSyncSchedulerFactory
classes.description: An enum providing a factory method to create a background sync scheduler suitable for the current iOS version, with fallback to a no-op scheduler.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the scheduling registration for background refresh tasks if supported.

methods.name: schedulePeriodicSync
methods.description: Schedules a periodic background refresh task to run after a specified minimum delay.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Cancels any scheduled background refresh tasks.

methods.name: handleAppRefresh
methods.description: Handles the execution of the background refresh task, performs the sync, and reschedules the next refresh.
